item.title: US FAA says it will phase out floppy disks from air traffic control by 2028
item.summary: The US FAA has announced plans to completely phase out the use of floppy disks in air traffic control systems by the year 2028. This update affects legacy aviation infrastructure. No action is required for software developers.

item.title: Claude Code's “Don't Ask Again” File Exposes Passwords and Keys in 1,122 Public Copies on GitHub
item.snippet: Passwords and API keys that developers typed into commands they approved in Claude Code are sitting in public GitHub repositories, where anyone can read them. item.summary: Claude Code's 'Don't Ask Again' feature inadvertently stores sensitive commands containing passwords and API keys into session histories exposed on GitHub. Developers using Claude Code are affected. Check public repositories and revoke any leaked credentials immediately.
